transcript: Command, Operative Vex on the northern lane. Relay nodes one through four are holding steady. Wait, voltage spike on the primary conduit! If that barrier drops, the whole sector goes dark. Rerouting auxiliary power through my wrist emitter now. Network stabilized. This lane stays ours.
synthesizer: eSpeak NG 1.52.0.1 (en-us+f3) with procedural acoustic warmth filter
emotional_arc_summary: Starts in calm tactical focus (0.0-5.15s), shifts sharply to surprise and urgent concern when a voltage spike hits the primary conduit (5.15-10.30s), transitions to intense focus while rerouting wrist-emitter power (10.30-12.65s), and concludes with joy/confidence once the lane network stabilizes (12.65-14.50s).
